in_marathi.name: Sthir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Firm, steadfast, unwavering
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sthir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'sthira', meaning 'to be firm, steadfast, unwavering, or stable'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Sthira-Bhuta-Prasada-Rupa, which translates to 'one who is pleased with the firmness of the earth'.

in_bengali.name: Sthir

in_bengali.long_meaning: Sthir একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'sthira', meaning 'to be firm, steadfast, unwavering, or stable'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Sthira-Bhuta-Prasada-Rupa, which translates to 'one who is pleased with the firmness of the earth'.
